description: Census Data is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Bureau of Statistics. Census data products provided by the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS), including demographic, education, employment and household data from the 2001 to 2021 Censuses. Includes online tables for QuickStats, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander People Profiles, General Community Profiles, Time Series Profiles, and Working Population Profiles. Profiles are also available in Excel (XLSX) format. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as less than annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
